Its fluidic design brings a sleek, modern look, while delivering 235 CMM air delivery at 330 RPM with a 4 Star rating for efficient everyday cooling.

title: Crompton SilentPro Enso Senze IoT - India's MOST Silent Fan

Aerodynamic anti-dust blades ensure strong air delivery and easier maintenance, while its premium fluidic design adds a modern touch to your interiors.

With high-quality brass terminals and universal sockets, it delivers dependable performance while supporting a wide range of plug types. Its 16A high-capacity design and 2 m long cable offer flexibility for everyday use at home or the office. Built with a fire-retardant body, it ensures added safety, while the compact, plug-and-play design makes it easy to use and carry wherever you need it.

title: Crompton 3 Way Multiplug Plugmate Lite
body_html: The Crompton 3-Way Multiplug Plugmate Lite is a compact and convenient way to power multiple everyday devices from a single socket. Its fire-retardant polycarbonate body and nickel-plated brass contacts ensure safe, reliable, and long-lasting performance. Lightweight, portable, and plug-and-play, it is perfect for use at home, in the office, or while travelling.

title: Crompton 4 Way Multiplug Plugmate Max
body_html: The Crompton 4-Way Multiplug Plugmate Max lets you power multiple everyday devices from a single socket with ease. Its fire-retardant polycarbonate body and durable nickel-plated brass contacts ensure safe and reliable performance. Compact, lightweight, and plug-and-play, it is a convenient solution for use at home, in the office, or while travelling.

body_html: The Crompton DynaRay LED Bulb delivers bright, energy-efficient lighting for everyday use. Its 6500K cool daylight output provides clear visibility, making it ideal for kitchens, utility areas, and workspaces. The B22 base ensures quick, hassle-free installation, while its wide operating voltage range offers reliable performance even during voltage fluctuations. With a compact, lightweight design, it is easy to install and built for dependable everyday lighting. Its efficient performance helps reduce energy consumption while providing consistent illumination, making it a practical and long-lasting lighting solution for your home.

body_html: The Crompton Solarium DLX Water Heater is designed to deliver reliable hot water with long-lasting performance. Its anti-scale technology helps reduce mineral buildup for efficient heating, while Smart Shield corrosion protection enhances durability over time.
